items.title: 54270_Doc Cheatham oral history interview
items.q: Bud Johnson was the contractor for the band... So they sent for me to come up there just to play the introduction.

ctx.x: Yeah, he was in that -- made that session. They were having some trouble with getting the trumpet player to play the introduction, Bud Johnson was the contractor for the band. And he wrote something that the trumpet players couldn't play. So they sent for me to come up there just to play the introduction. I think the tune was "Turn Back the Clock," so I went up there and I played the introduction and that was all. I could go on back to the studio.
That's allyou did, just play the introduction?
